---
description: Generate the model diagram views with the deterministic layout script
---

Run this in the terminal and wait for it to finish:

`node tools/generate-diagramLayout.mjs`

- Do not run `npm run build`.
- Do not edit or create any other files, and do not commit.
- If the script fails, show the error message and stop.

When it succeeds, reply with only the views it created and the table count for each, as a short list.
